about.title: Personalized care, brought to you.
about.introduction: I'm Shirlei Aube, a Licensed Massage Therapist dedicated to creating a thoughtful, personalized experience in the comfort of your own home.
about.experience: I believe that true relaxation begins when you feel comfortable and cared for. That's why I bring everything needed for your session — from a professional massage table and fresh linens to oils and essential supplies — so you can simply unwind.
about.specialties: Whether you're seeking the gentle relaxation of Swedish Massage, relief from muscle tension through Deep Tissue, or the restorative benefits of Sports Massage, every session is thoughtfully tailored to your individual needs.
